reviewer: Independent AI evaluation agent; no human study
rubric_interpretation: Pass requires a relevant conversational response fulfilling the main request. A generic acknowledgement alone does not satisfy a request with explicit content preferences. Surface plausibility and exact sentence novelty are separate from correctness.

decisions.reason: Run-on greeting imports OpenAssistant large-language-model identity, which is not this system.
Acknowledges pleasant user state and honestly denies human experience.

Unrelated glassworking warning replaces response to accepting a rest.
Reading follow-up mutates into a truncated claim to have personally witnessed ancient Egypt.
Switches reading preference to writing a letter for an unmentioned Marie.
Relevant music preference follow-up.
Does not answer assistant preference; incoherent relationship advice intrudes.

Invites the user to choose a topic without imposing advice.

Responds to user-reported rain without claiming weather access.
